## New or changed articles

<!-- CI checks the mechanical rules (docs/source-rules.md). Tick these by hand: -->

- [ ] Fits ACKB: main value is designing, modifying, repairing or documenting electronic musical
      instruments, or it explains a concept that already has an ACKB tag (docs/source-rules.md)
- [ ] Primary or technically deep source (not a shop page or aggregator)
- [ ] Summary in my own words, describing this article
- [ ] Author credited; license notes (e.g. "non-commercial") added where the site states them
- [ ] Nothing copied (no images, no text)
- [ ] Filters still fit: new tags have a group, long filter groups considered for a subgroup
